author: Swinhoe, 1867
summary: 해안 앞바다의 섬에 살며 일부 지역에서는 흔한 여름철새이다. 섬의 바위틈이나 슴새가 쓰던 땅굴, 또는 스스로 판 깊이 1m에 이르는 땅굴에 둥지를 틀고, 흰 알 1개를 암수가 함께 품는다. 국내에서는 서해안과 독도에 살며, 국외로는 일본의 섬들과 중국, 타이완, 싱가포르, 수마트라, 자바, 인도양에 분포한다.

art.subject: Swinhoe's Storm Petrel (Hydrobates monorhis), adult in summer (breeding season around Korean offshore islands): whole plumage dark sooty brown, the forehead and crown the same dark colour as the rest of the head, with no pale cap; on each upperwing a paler greyish-brown diagonal band across the coverts from the bend of the wing towards the body; primaries, secondaries and tail blackish; underparts and underwing dark greyish-brown with no white anywhere; rump dark, the same colour as the back; tail blackish with a shallow fork; short, fine black bill with a small tube on top and only a tiny hook at the tip; dark eye; short black legs and feet.
art.pose: flying low over the sea, wings spread
art.scene: Korean summer sea beside a rocky offshore island; no people, buildings or text
views: adult in flight seen from directly above, head pointing straight forward in line with the body and tail so that only the crown shows: all dark sooty-brown head, body and rump, blackish flight feathers, a paler greyish-brown diagonal band across each upperwing, blackish tail with a shallow fork

adult, side view resting low on rock at a burrow entrance, belly close to the ground and the short legs mostly hidden: small all-dark sooty-brown bird, head the same dark colour as the body, short fine black bill with a small tube on top, long folded wings, blackish tail with a shallow fork
art.build: Small seabird, about 20cm: about the length of a Barn Swallow but with longer, broader, angled wings and a fuller body. Small rounded head, short neck. Bill black, short and fine, much shorter than the head, with a small tube on top of the upper mandible and only a tiny hook at the tip; it is not deep or raptor-like. Legs short, thin and black; on land the bird rests low with the belly near the ground and shuffles rather than standing upright. In flight the feet do not project beyond the tail. Wings long and pointed, sharply bent at the wrist. Tail with a shallow fork and no long outer streamers. Flies low over the sea with buoyant, bounding flight and erratic changes of direction.
avoid: Do not paint a white rump; Swinhoe's Storm Petrel has a dark rump, unlike Leach's Storm Petrel.
Do not paint a deeply forked, swallow-like tail with long points; the fork is shallow.
Do not paint a heavy, deep, strongly hooked bill like a raptor or skua; the bill is short and fine with only a tiny hook.
Do not paint a pale forehead or pale cap; the whole head is as dark as the body.
Do not stand it upright on long legs like a songbird; on land it rests low on very short legs.
Do not paint white underparts or a white band on the underwing.
